stories.title: Trump and Xi open Washington summit as US-China trade truce is extended to January 2027
stories.reason: Bessent's pre-summit deal buys time before formal talks on rare earths, AI and Taiwan, with Beijing threatening to walk away if Washington approves new arms sales to Taipei and both sides still far apart on critical-mineral export controls.

stories.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5.13%, its highest since 2007, as oil jumps back above $103
stories.reason: A weak Treasury auction, hot inflation data and renewed energy-price pressure are compounding the Fed's hawkish rate path, pushing mortgage rates to the highest point of Trump's second term and rattling stocks already on edge over the Iran war's economic fallout.

stories.title: Anthropic's looming IPO filing is spooking the market, as rival listings from Holtec and Bamboo Insurance get postponed
stories.reason: With Anthropic expected to raise more than SpaceX's record $85.7 billion once it files, other issuers say they can't get investor attention competing for the same pool of capital, leaving just a handful of US listings completed since Labor Day.

stories.title: DOJ defends Trump's White House media ban, calls press access a 'privilege -- not a right'
stories.reason: The filing, made as CNN, MS NOW and Politico seek an emergency court order restoring their credentials, argues the outlets' coverage jeopardized national security -- a claim a federal judge is now weighing against the news organizations' First Amendment challenge.

stories.title: Trump's Board of Peace proposes a $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction
stories.reason: The 66-project, six-month plan aims to jump-start recovery even as Israeli forces still occupy roughly 60% of Gaza, Hamas has not disarmed, and the promised international stabilization force has yet to deploy nearly a year after the ceasefire took effect.

stories.title: Senate Democrats press for a vote on China chip-export controls as Xi visits Washington
stories.reason: Elizabeth Warren accused Nvidia of being too eager to sell to China and argued AI export policy should be set by legislation rather than closed-door talks between the administration, Beijing and tech CEOs, timing the push to Xi's high-profile state visit.

stories.title: Verizon commits $70 million to a nationwide free AI-skills training program
stories.reason: The initiative pools courses from IBM, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Coursera and OpenAI into one free portal for job seekers, educators and small businesses, partly funded by a severance fund set up after Verizon's 13,000 job cuts this year.

stories.title: Yemen's displacement crisis tops 130,000 since September as Houthi advance widens the war
stories.reason: UNHCR says the rapid Houthi push down Yemen's western coast toward the Bab el-Mandeb Strait has driven fresh mass displacement centered on Taiz, adding to 5.2 million already uprooted in a country where over half the population now needs humanitarian aid.
